info.title: Reporters.io API
info.description: Search reporters and media outlets, browse indexed articles, and explicitly reveal eligible paid contacts. All authenticated API and MCP operations require an active Professional (Pro) subscription. Search returns bounded ranked snapshots; article text and live enrichment are not provided.

get.description:
Read the current plan, enabled capabilities, and key scopes.

Required key scope: `account:read`.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked, or expired API key.

403.description: An active Professional subscription and the required key scope are required.

404.description: Resource or eligible contact is unavailable.

409.description: Results changed or idempotency key was reused with different input.

429.description: Temporarily unavailable. Honor Retry-After and retry the same operation.

503.description: A required dependency is temporarily unavailable.

post.description:
Find reporters by topic, beats, and geography. Contacts require a separate explicit reveal.

Required key scope: `reporters:read`.

parameters.description: Recommended for searches and contact reveals. Reuse the same value and input for safe retries within 24 hours. Each new value identifies a new operation.
